high_level_description: The image depicts a triptych of paintings displayed on a white wall. The central panel is significantly larger than the two side panels, which are of equal size. Each panel features a deep blue background, creating a cohesive visual theme. Left Panel: This panel shows a fantastical scene with several orange and black serpentine creatures that resemble dragons or mythical sea serpents. These creatures appear to be emerging from the water, with their bodies curving and tails trailing behind them. The creatures have a somewhat ethereal quality, as if they are rising from the depths.
